scripts.dev: sh -c 'test -f config.local.yaml || { echo "gateway dev requires config.local.yaml (copy config.example.yaml)" >&2; exit 1; }; exec cargo run -p sibyl-gateway-server --bin sibyl-gateway --locked -- --config config.local.yaml'
scripts.test:e2e: sh -c 'cd tests/e2e && npx -y pnpm@11 install --no-frozen-lockfile && npx -y pnpm@11 test'
